also, we live within the kingdoms of this world, and we can often feel battered, bruised and disillusioned by the lifestyles, politics and values of these kingdoms. i n today’s gospel jesus reassures us that this is ok . we live within the kingdoms of this world and it is morally correct to support them in so far as we have to, but (and this is cruci al) our allegiance, our loyalty and the way we live our lives must always be to the kingdom of god. jesus warns of hypocrisy – calling ourselves citizens of god’s kingdom and its currency of love, whiles upporting or condoning the currency of the kingdoms of this world – injusti ce, judgement, intolerance, sarcasm, violence, fear. the re is so much to learn from today’s gospel which is relevant to us and our place in our world. it certainly gives us plenty to reflect upon… collections 10th/11th october – development fund: €1,425 ; plate: €7 45 ; october offerings: €1,395 . thank you very much!
